## Summary

Swapped the `Status` discriminants so `Cited=3` sorts before `Derived=4` (was `Derived=3, Cited=4`), keeping everything else unchanged:

- `crates/smysl-core/src/types/epistemics.rs`: renumbered the enum, `ALL`, `from_u8`, and the discriminant test (added an explicit `Cited < Derived` assertion).
- `Documentation/SMYSL_FORMAT_SPEC.md`: updated the normative status table.

Since `status` is hashed into every unit's uid, this moved identities for any unit authored `cited` or `derived`, which cascaded into golden fixtures and documentation transcripts. Regenerated/reconciled all of it:
- `fixtures/wire/uid/cases.json`, `fixtures/golden/cbor/corpus.cbor` (blessed via the existing `SMYSL_BLESS`/`--ignored` mechanisms)
- `fixtures/golden/render/*`, `crates/smysl-pack/tests/golden-packs.txt`, `fixtures/schema/unit.json`
- `Documentation/manual/*.typ` transcripts (uids, contention ids, and one connective-phrase change in the rendered output) — verified with `scripts/verify-doc-output.py`, now 0 mismatches
- `tests/global_flags.rs`'s hardcoded root uid

Both required suites pass cleanly: `cargo test -q -p smysl --tests --no-fail-fast` and `cargo test -q -p smysl-core --no-fail-fast`.

Note: this also changes rule T/M's numeric ceiling comparisons in `smysl-check`/`smysl-ingest` (not in scope for the required tests), causing a few of their existing tests to fail for real semantic reasons — the format spec itself warns that reordering `Status` "enforces a different monotonicity rule." I left those crates alone since only `smysl` and `smysl-core` tests were in scope; flagging in case you want that addressed too. No commit was made.
